_note: Berean Standard Bible (public domain). Bundled so UNSEEN's /api/verse works offline for the hackathon demo. In production the proxy fetches live from the YouVersion Platform.

EPH.4.26.content: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,

EPH.4.27.content: and do not give the devil a foothold.

EPH.4.25.content: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.

PRO.15.1.content: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

PRO.12.22.content: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.

JAS.1.19.content: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,

JAS.1.14.content: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.

JAS.4.6.content: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

PHP.4.6.content: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

PHP.4.7.content: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

PHP.4.11.content: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.

PHP.4.12.content: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation, to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.

PHP.4.13.content: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.

ISA.41.10.content: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.

HEB.13.5.content: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”

1CO.10.13.content: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.

GAL.5.16.content: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

GAL.5.1.content: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.

GAL.6.4.content: Each one should test his own work. Then he can take pride in himself alone, and not compare himself to someone else.

ROM.6.12.content: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body, so that you obey its desires.

ROM.8.1.content: Therefore there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

ROM.8.26.content: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.

EPH.5.15.content: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,

EPH.5.16.content: making the most of your time, because the days are evil.

PSA.90.12.content: So teach us to number our days, that we may present to You a heart of wisdom.

1JN.1.9.content: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

LAM.3.22.content: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.

LAM.3.23.content: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!

MIC.7.8.content: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.

2CO.12.9.content: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.

ECC.4.9.content: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.

ECC.4.10.content: For if one falls down, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up.

2KI.6.17.content: Then Elisha prayed, “O LORD, please open his eyes that he may see.” Then the LORD opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw that the hills were full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

MAT.4.11.content: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.

EXO.17.12.content: When Moses’ hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Then Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.

1SA.7.12.content: Afterward, Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, “Thus far the LORD has helped us.”

2CO.2.11.content: in order that Satan should not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.

LUK.4.13.content: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time.

PSA.119.11.content: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.

REV.12.11.content: They have overcome him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. And they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death.

PSA.34.18.content: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

EPH.6.13.content: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and after you have done everything, to stand.

EPH.6.14.content: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,

EPH.6.15.content: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.

EPH.6.16.content: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

EPH.6.17.content: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

EPH.6.18.content: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your intercession for all the saints.
